title: Deciding where AI is worth building
deck_lead: A three week assessment that produces a ranked set of AI use cases, a readiness score against the platform and data they already have, and a roadmap the executive team can fund. Client-specific slides are marked and filled during the pursuit.

slides.title: What changes
slides.left_lead: Interest in AI without an agreed place to start.
left: Use cases are proposed by function with no shared ranking.
Nobody has scored the data against what an AI use case would need.
Governance questions surface late and stall approval.
Platform gaps are discovered during a build rather than before it.
slides.right_lead: A ranked set of use cases with a readiness score behind each one.
right: Use cases ranked by value and by feasibility.
A readiness score across data, platform, and governance.
A roadmap sequenced so the first build is the one most likely to land.
An executive readout that supports a funding decision.

slides.title: The engagement
slides.subtitle: What the engagement covers and how it runs.

slides.title: Why this approach fits
slides.pick_note: A three week advisory engagement led by a subject matter expert, with analyst support. It produces a decision, not a build.

reasons.head: The question is where to start, not whether to build
reasons.body: Assessing readiness before committing to a use case costs three weeks and avoids funding a build the data cannot support.

reasons.head: Governance is assessed up front
reasons.body: Risk and governance review runs inside the assessment rather than arriving as a blocker after a build is underway.

reasons.head: The output is fundable
reasons.body: The roadmap carries ranked use cases and a readiness score, which is what an executive team needs to release budget.

items.name: AI vision and use case discovery
items.detail: Facilitated sessions to surface and frame candidate use cases across the in-scope functions.

items.name: AI maturity scoring
items.detail: Scored assessment of current capability against a defined maturity model.

items.name: Platform and integration readiness review
items.detail: Assessment of the platform and integration estate against what the candidate use cases require.

items.name: Data quality and availability assessment
items.detail: Review of the data the candidate use cases depend on, with gaps named.

items.name: AI governance and risk review
items.detail: Review of policy, approval, and risk controls needed before a build proceeds.

items.name: AI readiness report and roadmap
items.detail: Ranked use cases, readiness scores, and a sequenced roadmap.

items.name: Executive readout
items.detail: Findings and roadmap presented to the sponsor group for a funding decision.

slides.title: Scope boundaries
in_scope: Facilitated discovery across the agreed functions.
Maturity scoring against a defined model.

out_scope.item: Any build, configuration, or model development

out_scope.route: Scoped separately once gaps are known

slides.callout: Each exclusion routes to a scoped next step.
